notes.title: Paparazzi is out today!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!

We're incredibly excited to finally get Paparazzi off the ground. This game has been a long and bumpy road for us and it's finally time to see it release. We hope that you enjoy it; despite it being a small game, we tried to put a lot of heart into it.

I want to make one quick note: 
Play Paparazzi with a friend! 
We intended from the beginning for Paparazzi to be a light and silly competition between friends. We love the atmosphere of being side by side at your computer, and so we designed the game to suit that!

Thanks, and I hope you'll enjoy the game!

Joel

notes.title: Paparazzi Out 2/17/15!
notes.notes:
Paparazzi will be available this coming Tuesday -- February 17th, 2015!

In addition to grabbing in on Steam, you'll be able to find it on Nintendo Wii U (in the Nintendo eShop) and on Playstation 4 (in the Playstation Store)!
